$comment: Scene grammar for Infinite Doors. Enforced by tools/validate.mjs, consumed by game/engine.js. Extending this file is a deliberate act: engine + validator must change with it, in their own commit.

title.note: Shown faintly on entry. Lowercase, evocative, under 40 chars.

art.note: Repo-relative path to the scene SVG, normally world/scenes/<id>.svg

caption.note: One line of prose shown on entry. Optional. Never explain the puzzle.

region.note: Loose grouping for the curator, e.g. 'hall', 'ship', 'seabed'.

craft.note: How finished the ARTWORK is, on the ladder in STYLE.md. New scenes are built at 2. An ENRICH run raises exactly one scene by exactly one rung and never skips. This is a ratchet: it only ever goes up, which is what stops unattended polish runs from redrawing the same room forever.

hotspots.note: Every scene must reward at least two clicks.

ambience.note: 1-2 patch names from world/soundscape.json — the scene's air. Every scene must have a sound, even if it is nearly silence.

shape.note: CSS id selector for an element inside the scene SVG. The drawn object IS the click target — never a separate invisible rectangle.

label.note: Accessible name, read by screen readers and shown as a tooltip.

target.note: Scene id to travel to. Must exist.

clip.note: CSS class defined in the scene SVG's <style> block.

clipTarget.note: Bare element id to animate instead of the clicked element.

clipMs.note: Animation length in ms, used to strip the class afterwards. Default 2400.

text.note: Prose shown in the toast. Optional alongside animate.

hint.note: A note to the FUTURE BUILDER describing what lies behind this door. Never shown to the player. This is the seed a later EXPAND run grows from.

sets.note: Flag name set when this fires. Persisted in localStorage.

requires.note: Hotspot is inert until this flag is set. Use sparingly; a scene must never become unplayable.

once.note: Fires a single time, then the hotspot is spent.

sound.note: One-shot patch name from world/soundscape.json, played on click. goto and frontier have engine defaults (door-pass, door-shut); set this only when a click deserves its own voice.
